concerns.text: Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires that all random seeds be explicitly pinned and that the pipeline be runnable end‑to‑end without manual intervention. No task in the current list documents the pinning of seeds (e.g., in a `code/config.py` or a dedicated seed‑initialisation task). Add a task (e.g., T013) that records the seed values and verifies that the full pipeline can be executed from a clean checkout.

Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) mandates a Reference‑Validator Agent run to confirm that every external citation (NLCD URL, literature references) is reachable and matches the primary source before research can be accepted. No task currently invokes or records this validation step. Add a task (e.g., T014) that runs the Reference‑Validator Agent and fails the pipeline if any citation is unreachable or mismatched.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) states that checksums must be recorded under the project’s `state/` artifact‑hashes map. Task T001 writes a checksum only to `data/raw/nlcd_30m_co_meta.json`; it does not update the `state/` manifest. Add a task (e.g., T015) that writes the SHA‑256 checksum of every data artifact to `state/projects/PROJ-421‑...yaml` and validates the manifest.

Functional Requirement FR‑006 requires the pipeline to run on a CPU‑only environment. Task T010 validates wall‑clock time and RAM but does not assert that no GPU resources are used or that the code explicitly disables CUDA. Add a check (or a separate task) that confirms the execution environment lacks GPU devices and that any optional GPU libraries are not imported.
